mapper.select: SELECT s.*,v.state_json AS financial_state_json FROM expense_split_routing_source s JOIN expense_report_revision v ON v.tenant_id=s.tenant_id AND v.report_id=s.source_report_id AND v.financial_version=s.source_financial_version WHERE s.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND s.report_id=#{reportId} AND s.round_no=#{roundNo} ORDER BY s.ordinal

SELECT e.*,a.version AS candidate_application_version,a.status AS candidate_status,a.round_no AS candidate_round_no, s.round_no AS candidate_frozen_round,s.status AS candidate_frozen_status FROM expense_report e JOIN approval_application a ON a.tenant_id=e.tenant_id AND a.id=e.application_id LEFT JOIN approval_submission_round s ON s.tenant_id=a.tenant_id AND s.application_id=a.id AND s.round_no=a.round_no WHERE e.tenant_id=#{argument1} AND e.employee_id=#{argument2} AND e.id<>#{argument3} AND a.status IN ('IN_APPROVAL','APPROVED') AND (e.current_round_no IS NULL OR (e.current_legal_entity_id=#{argument4} AND e.current_base_currency=#{argument5} AND e.current_submitted_at>=#{argument6} AND e.current_submitted_at<=#{argument7})) ORDER BY e.current_submitted_at,e.id
